user.title: Connect your R-Music core
user.description: Create a revocable API token with read and control scopes in R-Music Settings. Include the complete path prefix in the core URL. Certificate verification applies only to this core.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the R-Music API token
reauth_confirm.description: The existing token has expired or was revoked. Enter a new token with read and control scopes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the core. Check the address, port, path and certificate.
error.invalid_auth: Token expired, revoked or missing required scopes.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query or fragment.

abort.wrong_core: The URL belongs to a different configured core. Add it as a separate integration.
